edits.new: Record exactly one open-ended counterexample question per direction, naming both nodes and describing a concrete potential case. It may test any applicable parent condition or permitted topic connection. State what the case attempts to violate while attempting to preserve every child requirement. The question establishes neither admission nor exclusion.
edits.old: Record exactly one open-ended counterexample question per direction, naming both nodes and describing a concrete potential case. Choose an applicable parent identity or consumer restriction not explicit in the child's meaning before any other condition. Put an entity outside that required identity, or a consumer outside the required class, in the role the restriction constrains. State the attempted violation in the question even if you expect a necessary child implication to rule it out; assess that implication in the answer rather than selecting an already-qualifying entity or a different condition. Otherwise choose another absent qualification; if none applies, test a shared condition or permitted topic connection. Attempt to preserve every child requirement. The question establishes neither admission nor exclusion.

edits.new: A valid counterexample establishes failure of coverage; no further restriction test is required to refute that direction. Before concluding full coverage, explicitly test each applicable parent identity or consumer restriction absent from the child's explicit wording. Put an entity outside the required class in the constrained role and adjudicate that concrete case against the whole child meaning and every parent alternative and permitted topic connection. If a necessary implication excludes the case, identify it. Otherwise, establish that every case in every child alternative is covered by at least one parent alternative or permitted topic connection, satisfying all its applicable requirements. Continue checking other parent requirements if the first case fails, prioritizing further absent qualifications before shared conditions. Give a valid counterexample if found, a full-coverage conclusion if established, or null if admission, exclusion or necessary coverage remains unresolved. The justification must identify the tested restriction and give the decisive basis.
edits.old: A valid counterexample establishes failure of coverage. Continue checking other parent requirements if the first case fails, prioritizing further absent qualifications before shared conditions. Give a valid counterexample if found, a full-coverage conclusion if established, or null if admission, exclusion or necessary coverage remains unresolved. edits.new: Before approving each required ancestor or descendant containment, apply the same full-coverage prerequisite and resolve its concrete tests in `reason`; passing the selected-node comparison does not discharge them.
edits.old: For every required ancestor or descendant relationship, repeat the same counterexample tests, including concrete tests of applicable identity or consumer restrictions absent from that child's explicit wording. Resolve these cases in `reason`; passing the selected-node comparison does not discharge them.
